mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND status!='DELETED'
SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND status!='DELETED' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE organization_id=#{organizationId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,health_examination_batch_id,service_id,document_template_version_id,service_code_snapshot,service_name_snapshot, negotiated_unit_price,currency,display_order,status,created_at,updated_at FROM public.health_examination_batch_services WHERE health_examination_batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY display_order,id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_batches SET batch_code=#{batchCode},batch_name=#{batchName},start_date=#{startDate}, end_date=#{endDate},reason=#{reason},payer_type=#{payerType},examination_site_type=#{examinationSiteType}, examination_site_name=#{examinationSiteName},examination_site_address=#{examinationSiteAddress},status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO public.health_examination_batch_services(id,health_examination_batch_id,service_id,document_template_version_id, service_code_snapshot,service_name_snapshot,negotiated_unit_price,currency,display_order,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{item.id},#{item.healthExaminationBatchId},#{item.serviceId},#{item.documentTemplateVersionId},#{item.serviceCodeSnapshot}, #{item.serviceNameSnapshot},#{item.negotiatedUnitPrice},#{item.currency},#{item.displayOrder},#{item.status},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET negotiated_unit_price=EXCLUDED.negotiated_unit_price,display_order=EXCLUDED.display_order,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batch_services s WHERE AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batch_participant_services p WHERE p.health_examination_batch_service_id=s.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_import_rows r WHERE r.resolved_batch_service_id=s.id)))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batch_participants WHERE health_examination_batch_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_import_jobs WHERE health_examination_batch_id=#{id})
mapper.sql: organization_id=#{organizationId} AND status!='DELETED' AND (LOWER(batch_code) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE chr(92) OR LOWER(batch_name) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE chr(92))
mapper.select: SELECT id,batch_code,batch_name,start_date,end_date,status,created_at,updated_at FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE ORDER BY batch_codebatch_name start_datestatus created_atid DESCASC,id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
